question: Which scientist discovered the first pulsar in 1967, and what university was she studying at?
answer: Jocelyn Bell Burnell (Susan Jocelyn Bell) discovered the first radio pulsar (PSR B1919+21) in 1967. She was a doctoral student at the University of Cambridge, doing her PhD at New Hall, Cambridge (completed 1969) under Antony Hewish. Source: Wikipedia article on Jocelyn Bell Burnell (doc 47806).

notes.fact: Jocelyn Bell Burnell detected the first radio pulsar (PSR B1919+21, "LGM-1") on 28 November 1967 in chart-recorder papers from the Interplanetary Scintillation Array. She did her PhD at New Hall, Cambridge (PhD 1969), supervised by Antony Hewish.
